name: MineMsg
meaning: Messages handled by Mine_HandleMessage 0x4d505c, GroundMine_HandleMessage 0x4d5f98 and DefusableMine_HandleMessage 0x4d7347 (ids are per receiver)

name: MSG_KILL
meaning: blast: arg 0 in state 2 -> countdown (0.1665 s, not cancellable); chain reaction

name: MSG_USE
meaning: DefusableMine: start defusal (-> state 6), no state check

name: MSG_QUERY_ACTION
meaning: DefusableMine: 4 CTX_PICKUP in state 0 (Wolf/Robot); 0xC CTX_DEFUSE in state 2 while dormant (Wolf only)

name: MSG_PICKUP
meaning: DefusableMine: attach to the sender joint, state 0

name: MSG_DROP
meaning: DefusableMine: arg {Vec3s pos; u16 flags}; flags & 1 re-arms (state 1)

name: MSG_SEESAW_TOUCH
meaning: GroundMine: start falling unless attached; returns 0

name: MSG_FREEZE
meaning: DefusableMine: from the Wolf, aborts a defusal in state 7/8 back to armed state 2

name: MSG_CINE_END
meaning: base: savedPos = pos if in world

name: MSG_RIDER_ADD
meaning: GroundMine: mover = sender if empty (Magnet); returns 1 always

name: MSG_RIDER_REMOVE
meaning: GroundMine: clear mover if sender; returns 1

name: MSG_DETECTOR_PING
meaning: MineDetector cone search: non-zero = detectable. Mines return 1 (GroundMine only in proximity mode); GoldenCoins return 1 and reveal themselves

name: MSG_MAGNET_QUERY
meaning: GroundMine: 1 = magnetic (proximity mode only). Sent by Magnet_Update 0x4d235e

name: MSG_DETECTOR_RAY
meaning: GroundMine: returns the distance along the sender's facing to open hazard (GroundMine_RayToHazard), INT_MAX = none
